descriptionHtml:
Quilted right across. Low padded edge. The tray stops being a tray.

Glenridding is a quilted dog crate mattress with low padded sides and a 30°C washable cover, in Small 70 × 50cm, Medium 90 × 60cm and Large 105 × 70cm.

Listen to a crate at two in the morning. They shift, and the tray answers back. The blanket you folded in there has already been shoved into one corner, and they are lying half on plastic, which is roughly when they give up and go and sleep on the kitchen tiles instead.

Quilting holds the fill in place across the whole base rather than letting it drift to the edges, and the mattress is cut flat enough to lie inside a crate without folding.

What they get

  • Quilting across the whole base: The fill is stitched where it was put, so it does not migrate into one corner overnight.
  • A low padded edge: High enough to rest a chin on. Low enough that it does not fight the crate door on the way shut.
  • A cover that washes at 30°C: It unzips and goes in the machine, which is the difference between crate bedding and a crate liner.
  • Three sizes, 70 × 50cm to 105 × 70cm: Matched to the inside of a crate base, not the outside of the crate.

Best for: dogs who sleep in the crate all night, puppies still in the settling-in weeks, and anyone who wants the bedding in the machine on a Sunday morning.

Why it is worth the money

The Small is £49, the Medium £59 and the Large £79. The crate floor is where a lot of dogs spend the night and a good part of the day, which quietly makes it the most-used bed in the house. It is also the one most people furnish with an old towel.

And you are not gambling the money. If they have not claimed it within 100 nights, we collect it free from the UK mainland and refund you in full.

Worth knowing: this is a quilted mattress, not a deep foam one. The quilting cushions them off the tray. It will not hold a heavy dog's hips level the way a thick foam core does, and if that is what you are after, look at a foam mattress instead.

Size and fit

SizeDimensions (cm)What to know
Small70 × 50The smallest crate base
Medium90 × 6020cm longer than the Small
Large105 × 70The largest crate base of the three

Measure the inside of your crate base, not the outside of the crate, and choose the size that lies flat without bunching or blocking the door. If it is going on a floor rather than in a crate, measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Message us your crate size and we will tell you honestly which one fits.

Everyday care

Wash the removable cover at 30°C, following the sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting.

A bed is a comfort accessory, not a vehicle restraint.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.
